content.title: Wayne Riley Previews The 2025 US Masters For William Hill
content.text: The Masters is one of the biggest golf events of the season and the eyes of the world will be on the first major of the calendar year. Former professional golfer Wayne ‘Radar’ Riley is here to preview this year’s event and golf betting punters will be keen to hear his thoughts on the week ahead. Augusta National is one of the most recognisable golf courses on the planet and it’ll be interesting to see who comes out on top on Sunday evening. Here, we look at some of Wayne’s picks for the 2025 Masters tournament, as well as an incredible promotional offer for William Hill players so let’s get straight to it… Who Wins The Masters In 2025? We asked Wayne ‘Radar’ Riley for his top selections for the 2025 Masters at Augusta National and he landed on a few – you can read his best Masters tips below: Scottie Scheffler Wayne Riley: “My top pick is Scottie Scheffler for obvious reasons. He’s won here two out of the last three years.” Tyrell Hatton Wayne Riley: “I think that Tyrell Hatton has a good chance here of winning the Masters, he’s a great wedge player and comes here in decent form, having won in Dubai this year.” Shane Lowry Wayne Riley: “I think Shane Lowry has a wonderful opportunity of winning. He’s got great imagination and that’s what you need here at Augusta National. A wonderful imagination.” At the time of writing, Scottie Scheffler is one of the Masters favourites in 2025 and he will have plenty of supporters given his record around Augusta National. The Masters 2025 Outsider Of The Week Wayne Riley is backing Bryson DeChambeau to go well at Augusta this week and he is a 14/1 shot with William Hill ahead of The Masters. You can read his reasoning behind the selection below: Wayne Riley: “He did alright a couple of years back, he won the US Open last year. He’s got to be an outsider because he’s playing on that LIV Tour. He’s not playing against the best players. “I think the golf course suits him. He’s not coming in here on the LIV Tour with great form but it’s a golf course, Augusta, it’s quite wide off the tee and he hits it as far as anybody and there’s no reason why he can’t prevail here. “His odds are a little longer but I think for me he is an outsider and that’s who I’m going with as my outsider for the US Masters.” MONEY BACK if Rory McIlroy Wins The Masters William Hill are giving golf fans a fantastic offer ahead of this week’s event at Augusta National, with money back as a free bet if Rory McIlroy wins the Masters. But what does Wayne Riley think? Wayne Riley: “For the last month, people have been asking me who’s going to win the Masters and I haven’t mentioned Rory McIlroy once because I’m very close to the family and I’m very close to Rory McIlroy. “The last 10 years coming here, I’ve been saying that Rory McIlroy’s going to win the Masters so I’ve just stayed away from it. Look, there will never be a better time for Rory McIlroy to win The Masters. He’s coming in here off two great wins, at Pebble Beach and the Players Championship. “To win the career Grand Slam, to go down with the players which I call ‘The Immortals’, to join that list would be phenomenal. And I hope he does it, he’s got a great chance.”
